title: Godot 4.7 freezes randomly on arch labwc with wayland
body:
### Tested versions

Reprodudible in:  Godot Engine   v4.7.dev.mono.arch_linux [8fb5cd877]

installed through yay -S godot-mono-git

### System information

Godot v4.7.dev.mono (8fb5cd877) - EndeavourOS #1 SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Sun, 11 Jan 2026 17:10:53 +0000 on Wayland - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 2 monitors - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 Laptop GPU - AMD Ryzen 5 5600H with Radeon Graphics (12 threads) - 62.64 GiB memory

### Issue description

In 30min window godot froze 2 times.

As far as I've noticed this issue happens maybe when godot tries to reload scripts ?

First time it happened is when I was editing the .csproj file of a scene, second time it happend is when I attached a script to a root control node of a scene or bit later when I opened and modified .tscn scene in external text editor (Kate) and tried to save it. (I don't know which is true because I wasn't paying that much of an attention. But I do know that after if froze I could save scene within Kate editor but from Godot it still showed that scene is modified and didn't let me to save or to do anything.

### Steps to reproduce


what I'd focus on to reproduce it is to try to add scripts to nodes open them in godot internal editor , also open them through nemo / nautilus file manager and or with external text editor such as Kate / gedit and trying to save from external editor or any permutation of these things.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)


you can use this simple 2mb project to try to reproduce it on your system.

[fisk2.tar.gz](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/24893438/fisk2.tar.gz)
